target_claim: bounded development result; formal MNCS and MNCDS status remain UNKNOWN
stimulus_sequence: three isolated desk taps separated by two seconds
voice at one meter for five seconds
cover and uncover A0 without touching the desk or piezo
exercise D3, D4, and D2 through every menu layer
power cycle and verify persisted settings
flash the rollback image and verify boot

measurement_policy.manual_markers: recorded on the host without transmission to the Uno
measurement_policy.clock: device milliseconds plus host monotonic elapsed time
measurement_policy.candidate_identity: SHA-256 of the exact sketch and decoder

selection_rule: The V5 candidate receives development PASS only when every hard gate passes. Missing hardware, compiler, persistence, or rollback evidence remains UNKNOWN.
